recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-13282 unless the work group reopens the model question and explicitly chooses to add interaction-level operation declarations.
issue_request: FHIR-13282 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked whether CapabilityStatement should expose operations at a resource interaction level because operations may be invoked at system, type, instance, and version-instance levels. The accepted resolution was to clarify the definition so readers consult the referenced OperationDefinition to see where the operation is supported.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 5f91feb9be52c8b5497fa906d169e33334e86de3, imported from svn revision 12857, which added the consultation sentence to the then-authoritative CapabilityStatement spreadsheet source. Later source refactoring moved the authoritative content into structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml, where the clarification remains with the typo corrected.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source distinguishes CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation from CapabilityStatement.rest.operation and directs readers to OperationDefinition; OperationDefinition.resource, system, type, and instance describe supported invocation scope. Later same-area FHIR-40957 terminology work does not alter this operation-scoping conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already implements the accepted clarification. Adding CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.interaction.operation would go beyond the published resolution and create another way to express operation support.

related_jiras.note: Later same-area clarification of REST interaction terminology; it reinforces the separation between REST interactions and Operations but does not require a FHIR-13282 source edit.
